text:
zoe: FYI from the onboarding lab: customers keep getting unclear error blobs from different SDKs. They don't know whether to retry, refresh, or contact support.
ash: +1. The sample app has three separate mappings across JS/Go/Py right now, which is brittle.
mani: Can we agree on a compact, flat error contract that every SDK emits? My take: name/type, http_status, code (enum), message, retryable, retry_after_ms (nullable), action, hint. Keep field names tiny and consistent with language idioms.
clare: I like the `action` field (instead of `intent`) because frontend teams already use that term. Suggested actions: `reauth`, `backoff`, `escalate`, `noop`. Frontend maps action->CTA.
zoe: Server notes: we'll ensure a normalized header `Retry-After` (sec | HTTP-date) and add `X-RW-Error-Code` for code enums. Clients should normalize to retry_after_ms.
ash: Also important: streaming responses sometimes include error objects inside a 200 payload: {"error": {"code": "quota"}}. SDKs must inspect and convert to thrown errors instead of returning partial content.
mani: Proposed status -> action mapping draft:
  400 -> noop / BadRequest (retryable=false)
  401 -> reauth (code: invalid_token | revoked)
  403 -> escalate (permission issues)
  404 -> noop
  408/429/503 -> backoff (include retry_after_ms when available)
  5xx -> backoff (502/503/504 retryable=true)

clare: For 401 we should differentiate: invalid_token => action=reauth & retryable=true; revoked => action=escalate & retryable=false with hint to contact support.
zoe: Example normalized error object we'd produce in SDKs (stringified payload):
{
  "type": "AuthError",
  "http_status": "401",
  "code": "invalid_token",
  "message": "access token expired",
  "retryable": "true",
  "retry_after_ms": "null",
  "action": "reauth",
  "hint": "call POST /auth/refresh or prompt user to sign in"
}

mani: Extra field idea: `details` as an optional array-of-strings for machine tags (e.g., quota bucket id). Keep it optional to avoid verbosity.
clare: Edge case: proxies sometimes rewrite Retry-After. Infra can add `X-RW-Retry-After-Ms` for critical endpoints as a fallback.
zoe: Test matrix we need: delta-second header, HTTP-date header, body-embedded error, streaming-frame error, oauth invalid_token, oauth revoked_user. Add cross-SDK tests for each.
ash: Migration plan: add a compatibility shim in SDKs that maps old shapes to the new contract for one release cycle. Also update sample-app to show an action-driven UX.
infra-bot: Note: provisioning `X-RW-Error-Code` and `X-RW-Retry-After-Ms` will be rolled out to quota and rate-limit endpoints next sprint.
doc-bot: Created doc task: "SDK error contract: action field + retry normalization" assigned to @mani, due in 6 days.
zoe: I'll draft the RFC with the exact field list and starter code snippets for JS/Go/Py. Please drop unit test vectors into the RFC PR. Thanks everyone!
